observations: Two headlight assemblies are shown, one in photo 0 and one in photo 1.
Both headlights have a clear lens with a circular projector-style main beam and an amber turn signal section.
The housing is chrome or silver-colored metal with black plastic trim.
Photo 0 shows both headlights stacked, with visible damage to the upper one: a cracked or broken lens and missing internal components.
Photo 1 shows a single headlight from a front angle, with a clean lens and intact internal components.
The watermark 'CHIDI BMW' is visible on both photos, suggesting the seller may specialize in BMW parts.
The seller claims these are Xenon headlamps for a BMW 3 Series E46.
No visible branding or model numbers on the headlights themselves in either photo.
